items.text: Hanyuma y’ivyo, Yesu agendagenda mu bisagara no mu mihana, avuga Ubutumwa Bwiza bw’Ubwami bw’Imana. Bamwe cumi na babiri bari kumwe na we,
hamwe n’abagore yabohoye baboshwe n’impwemu mbi, akabakiza n’izindi ngwara, ari bo Mariya Magadalena yirukanywemwo abadayimoni indwi,
Yowana muka Kuza; umunyabigega wa Herode, Suzana hamwe n’abandi benshi. Abo bagore bashigikira Yesu n’abigishwa biwe bakoresheje uburyo bwabo.
Umusi umwe, abantu benshi bari bakoranye bavuye mu bisagara bitandukanye, maze Yesu abacira uwu mugani ati:
Ahejeje kubacira uwo mugani, yongerako ati:
Abigishwa biwe baca bamubaza insiguro y’uwo mugani.
Na we ababwira ati:
Nyina wa Yesu na bene nyina baje kumuraba babura aho baca ngo bamushikire kuko hari abantu benshi cane.
Umuntu umwe aca amubwira ati: “Nyoko na bene nyoko bahagaze hanze, bariko barakurondera.”
Yesu amwishura ati:
Umusi umwe Yesu yabariye abigishwa biwe ati:
Nuko batambukira mu bwato, bafata urugendo.
Bakiriko barasoza, Yesu arasinzira. Haca haduka umuyaga mwinshi mu kiyaga, maze ubwato butangura kwuzura amazi; bari bageramiwe cane.
Abigishwa baca baja kumuvyura bavuga bati: “Mwigisha, mwigisha, turapfuye!”
Nuko aravyuka akankamira uwo muyaga n’imipfunda, igihuhusi kirahagarara, ubwo nyene haba agahwekere!
Yesu aca abaza ba bigishwa ati:
Maze baratangara, bagira n’ubwoba bwinshi, batangura kubazanya bati: “Mbega uwu ni umuntu ki? Ategeka umuyaga n’amazi kandi bikamwumvira!”
Nuko barasoza bashika mu ntara ya Gerasene, hakurya y’ikiyaga harabana n’i Galilaya.
Yesu atambukiye ku nkengera y’ikiyaga, asanganirwa n’umugabo yarimwo abadayimoni, aje ava mu gisagara. Yari amaze igihe kirekire atambara impuzu canke ngo abe mu nzu; yaba mw’itongo ry’abapfuye.
Abonye Yesu, aca akoma induru, yikubita ku birenge vyiwe, asemerera n’ijwi rirenga ati: “Undonderako iki ga Yesu, Mwana w’Imana Musumbavyose? Ndakwinginze ntunkubagure imibabaro!”

Ivyo yabivuze kuko Yesu yari yategetse iyo mpwemu mbi kumuvamwo. Kenshi iyo mpwemu mbi imufashe, naho bamubohesha iminyororo n’amaguru yiwe bakayashira mu vyuma kugira ngo agume hamwe, yarabicagagura, iyo mpwemu mbi igaca imutwara kuyerera mu gahinga.
Yesu arayibaza ati:
Na yo iramwishura iti: “Nitwa Gitero,” kuko yarimwo abadayimoni benshi.
Abo badayimoni binginga Yesu ngo ntabarungike i kuzimu.
Hafi y’aho hari umukuku w’ingurube nyinshi zari ziragiwe ku musozi. Abo badayimoni binginga Yesu ngo abarungike muri izo ngurube, maze arabemerera.
Nuko ba badayimoni bava muri wa muntu, binjira muri za ngurube, na zo ziriruka zimanuka, zisuka mu kiyaga ziradwibira, zicwa n’amazi.
Abari baragiye izo ngurube babibonye baca bariruka, baja kubivuga mu gisagara no mu mihana.
Maze abantu bava mu gisagara baza kuraba ivyabaye. Bashitse aho Yesu ari, babona uwo muntu yavuyemwo abadayimoni, yicaye imbere ya Yesu, yambaye kandi afise ubwenge bukwiye, na bo bagira ubwoba.
Ababonye uko vyagenze baca babiganira ingene uwo muntu yari aboshwe n’abadayimoni yakize.
Nuko abantu bose bo mu ntara y’Abagerasene binginga Yesu ngo abavireho, kuko bari bagize ubwoba bwinshi. Yesu aca yurira ubwato arigira.
Wa mugabo yakize abadayimoni yinginga Yesu ngo bajane, ariko Yesu aramurungika, amubwira ati:
Wa muntu aca arataha aca hose mu gisagara, agenda arabwira abantu ivyo Yesu yamukoreye.
Yesu asubiye inyuma asanganirwa n’abantu benshi cane bari bamurindiriye.
Umugabo yitwa Yayiro, yari umukuru w’isinagogi, araza yikubita imbere y’ibirenge vya Yesu aramwinginga ngo bajane i muhira iwe,
kuko umukobwa wiwe yariko aracikana. Yari amufise ari umwe kandi yari afise imyaka nka cumi n’ibiri.
Yesu ari mu nzira agenda, yari akikijwe n’abantu benshi bamugunda.
Hariho umugore yari amaze imyaka cumi n’ibiri agwaye ingwara yo mu gitereko yo kuguma ava amaraso, vyaranse ko akira.
Aca yegera Yesu amuturutse inyuma, akora ku musozo w’impuzu yiwe. Ubwo nyene kwa kuva amaraso guca kurahera.
Yesu na we aca arabaza ati:
Bose babihakanye, Petero amubwira ati: “Mwigisha, abantu ni benshi kandi bariko barakugunda.”
Yesu aravuga ati:
Wa mugore abonye ko ico yakoze camenyekanye, aca aza ajugumira, yikubita imbere y’ibirenge vya Yesu, amubwirira imbere ya bose icatumye amukorako, kandi ko yaciye akira ako kanya nyene.
Yesu aca aramubwira ati:
Akiriko aravuga, haza umuntu avuye kwa Yayiro, wa mukuru w’isinagogi, amubwira ati: “Umukobwa wawe yamaze gucikana. Nta co ubandanya ugora umwigisha.”
Yesu nawe avyumvise aca abwira Yayiro ati:
Ashitse mu nzu kwa Yayiro ntiyemera ko hagira umuntu n’umwe binjirana, kiretse Petero, Yohana, na Yakobo, hamwe na se na nyina b’uwo mwana.
Ico gihe abantu bose bariko baramuririra. Yesu arababarira ati:
Na bo baramutwenga, kuko bari bazi neza ko umwana yapfuye.
Yesu aca afata ukuboko kwa wa mukobwa, amubwira ati:
Ubwo nyene impwemu yiwe imusubiramwo, arahaguruka. Maze Yesu ababwira ngo bamugaburire.
Abavyeyi biwe baratangara cane, ariko Yesu arabihanikiriza ngo ntihagire uwo babwira ivyabaye.
